# posst.app

## About
posst.app is an AI-powered social media posting service for small businesses in Australia. It automates daily posts to Facebook and Instagram with AI-generated images and captions.

## URL
https://posst.app

## Pages
- Landing page: https://posst.app/
- Privacy policy: https://posst.app/privacy
- Terms of service: https://posst.app/terms
- Blog: https://posst.app/blog/

## Pricing
- Standard: A$24.99/month
- Pro: A$34.99/month
- 30-day free trial on all plans
